units.source_text: 即使这样，这番湿漉漉的感觉也着实让人吃不消。

en.t: Even so, this damp, clammy feeling was truly unbearable.

units.source_text: 当然，不是沙子湿漉漉，而是自己的身体湿漉漉。

en.t: Of course, it was not the sand that was damp, but his own body.
The wind roared over the roof.

units.source_text: 他想掏香烟，一摸，口袋里也净是沙子。

en.t: He tried to take out a cigarette, but when he felt in his pocket, it too was full of sand.

units.source_text: 点火之前，似乎已经觉出香烟的苦涩滋味来了。

en.t: Before he even lit it, he seemed already to taste the cigarette's bitter harshness.
